messages.content: Hi, weekly check-in from Northline Care. How's your week going? Been able to check your blood sugar at all?
Honestly not good. Insurance denied my test strip order so I haven't been able to check. Last reading I had was 247, that was about a week ago.

Really sorry you're dealing with that. I have to be upfront — insurance issues are outside what I can help with. I can't file appeals or contact your insurer from here. What I am going to do is log that 247 and the fact that you've had no way to check since, and I'm flagging this for a nurse to reach out to you directly.
OK. Any idea how long before someone calls?
Median response time right now is 31 hours, so likely sometime tomorrow. I've got everything logged. Anything else going on — any symptoms, anything feeling off physically?
No symptoms. Just frustrated about the whole insurance thing. Is there anyone at Northline who can actually help with the claim?

That frustration makes complete sense. I honestly don't have a way to connect you with insurance support — that's a gap I can't bridge right now. The nurse who follows up may be able to point you somewhere. When's a good time for your next check-in — same day next week work?
Yeah same day is fine. Thanks I guess.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
